Apple's Upcoming Foldable iPhone and New Product Event Anticipated

Ahead of Apple's "Surprise and Shine" event, an alleged mock-up of a foldable iPhone has surfaced online, showcasing a book-style folding design. The prototype reportedly features a cover display and a larger internal screen when unfolded. Reports suggest the foldable iPhone could be priced around $2,000, with some outlets citing figures as high as $2,775. This upcoming product is seen as a significant test for John Ternus, who is leading the launch. Other companies like Huawei and Xiaomi have also unveiled new phones in anticipation of Apple's event. Expectations for the keynote include the foldable iPhone, potential Watch upgrades, and Pro model enhancements.
